name: glom-continuity
description: Local project checkpoints and reviewable handoffs across AI assistants.

interface.shortDescription: Resume a project without losing its next step.
interface.longDescription: Save project checkpoints, check referenced files, and exchange explicit handoffs. Local-only alpha; no model calls or completion authority.
